en.1: The journey begins! We will gather at San Francisco International Airport for check-in and prepare for our overnight flight. Please arrive at the airport three hours early and ensure all travel documents are ready. Rest well on the plane to save energy for the exciting trip ahead.
en.2: Crossing the International Date Line means experiencing a unique jump in time during the flight, where the clock is adjusted forward by one day, filling the journey with a sense of wonder. This is not only a physical phenomenon of jet lag but also like a magical show crossing through time, adding mystery to the trip. Using this precious rest time in flight to adjust the body and mind rhythm can reduce fatigue caused by time differences, making the body and spirit more refreshed upon arrival. Arriving in Taiwan at dawn, accompanied by the vitality and hope of a new day, awaits us to explore the local cultural charm and lifestyle, beginning an unforgettable adventure.

zh-TW.1: 旅程的起點！我們將在舊金山國際機場集合，辦理登機手續並準備搭乘跨夜航班。請務必提前三小時抵達機場，並確保所有旅行文件都已備妥。在飛機上好好休息，為即將到來的精彩旅程儲備體力。
zh-TW.2: 跨越國際換日線，意味著我們在飛行途中經歷了一次獨特的時間跳躍，時鐘向前調整一天，讓旅途充滿奇妙感。這不僅是時差的物理現象，更像是一場穿越時間的魔術表演，給旅程增添了神秘色彩。利用這段飛行中的寶貴休息時間，調整身心節奏，可以減輕時差帶來的疲憊，讓抵達後的身體和精神狀態更加充沛。清晨抵達台灣的光景，伴隨著新一天的朝氣與希望，正等待著我們去探索當地的文化韻味與生活風情，展開一段難忘的冒險。
